designations.fra: Variants within a family to be tested

eng: Variants within a family to be tested

terms.designation: Variants within a family to be tested

definitions.content: For any family, at least the variant with the highest number of verification scale intervals (n) and the variant with the smallest verification scale interval, e, shall be selected as EUTs. Further EUTs may be required according to 3.10.4.6. If a variant has both characteristics, one EUT may be sufficient.
